title: Docs illustrations
description: Preferred pairings for concrete tasks. Keep the same pairing wherever the topic appears.

items.subject: Sailboat
items.description: Starting the journey with a first connection.

items.subject: Anchor
items.description: Establishing a starting point.

items.subject: Ship’s wheel
items.description: Controlling how DBHub runs.

items.subject: Octopus
items.description: Several capabilities available through one server.

items.subject: Diving goggles
items.description: Looking closely at tables, columns, and indexes.

items.subject: Current
items.description: A request flowing through to its result.

items.subject: Message in a bottle
items.description: Packaging a reusable SQL operation.

items.subject: Coral
items.description: Several database connections branching from one process.

items.subject: Harbor
items.description: A place to run and inspect database tools.

items.subject: Porthole
items.description: A window into a tool’s output.

items.subject: Sea chart
items.description: Following the path of a request.

items.subject: Pressure gauge
items.description: Reading the current state of a connection.

items.subject: Lifebuoy
items.description: Protection around database access.

items.subject: Buoy
items.description: Marking boundaries such as row limits and timeouts.

items.subject: Treasure chest
items.description: Sensitive information used to connect to a database.

items.subject: Submarine
items.description: Reaching a database through an indirect route.

items.subject: Pearl shell
items.description: Making selected data available to a team.

title: Editorial metaphors
description: Use when the surrounding copy establishes the connection. These are not fixed feature symbols.

items.subject: Iceberg
items.description: The visible tip contrasts with the larger context cost below.

items.subject: Nautilus
items.description: A supporting image for query plans or investigating data issues.

items.subject: Sonar
items.description: Finding something that is not immediately visible.

items.subject: Shoal
items.description: Useful for connection pools or groups of sources when the copy names them.

items.subject: Ship’s bell
items.description: Drawing attention to release notes or important notices.

items.subject: Dock cleat
items.description: Keeping a connection in place.

items.subject: Lighthouse
items.description: Helping readers find their way through a guide or troubleshooting article.

items.subject: Clownfish
items.description: A friendly recurring character for sample data and first-run examples.
